brief: Hungary's commercial card/ATM/POS disclosure landscape is dominated by two card schemes with active HU press rooms — Mastercard (newsroom.mastercard.com/eu/hu, home of the 15-year 'Bankkártya Használati Szokások' survey and the Doppio acceptance-expansion programme) and Visa (visa.hu 'Visa szerkesztőség') — which publish HU-specific card penetration, contactless, mobile-wallet and acceptance-point figures earlier and more granularly than official statistics. On the acquiring/PSP side the richest operational numbers come from OTP Mobil/SimplePay via OTP Bank's news page (transaction counts, >23k partner merchants, average basket value), with Barion as the only actor publishing a transparent public price list; bank acquirers (OTP, K&H via khpos.hu, MBH, Erste via Global Payments) and independent terminal operators (Worldline/Bizpay, Nexi Central Europe, Fizetési Pont/OFSZ, Cardnet) disclose product detail but almost no volumes. ATM coverage is the weakest link: Euronet is the key independent deployer but its HU press page appears stale (counts dated 2016/2022), parent-company SEC filings give no Hungary breakout, and the most datable signals arrive indirectly through bank ATM-outsourcing notices and business-media reporting. Practical strategy: event-driven monitoring of scheme and operator press rooms as leading indicators, trade outlets (FinTechZone, Fintech.hu) as discovery feeds, and filed annual accounts from the Hungarian company register as the hard, legally-mandated proxy where operators publish no volumes.
